title: Sum of Compatible Numbers in Range I
summary: Given integers n and k, find the sum of all positive integers x that meet the criteria: the absolute difference between n and x is less than or equal to k, and the bitwise AND of n and x equals zero.
statement: Given integers n and k, find the sum of all positive integers x that meet the criteria: the absolute difference between n and x is less than or equal to k, and the bitwise AND of n and x equals zero.
constraints: A compatible x is positive and satisfies abs(n-x)<=k.
It must also satisfy the bitwise condition n & x == 0.
Return the sum of every compatible integer.
reference_solution:
def sum_compatible_numbers(n,k):
    return sum(x for x in range(max(1,n-k),n+k+1) if n&x==0)
hints: Enumerate the closed distance interval around n.
Clamp its lower endpoint to one.
Test n & x for every candidate.
Add exactly the candidates whose shared set-bit mask is zero.
editorial: Add exactly the candidates whose shared set-bit mask is zero.

tests.explanation: The compatible values are one, four, and five, whose sum is ten.
Neither four nor six has bitwise AND zero with five, so return zero.
